module.name: D&D5e Death Token Effects
module.description: Displays the D&D 5e death icon over the token based on death saving throw failures and applies the Dead status when 3 failures are reached.

deadImage.name: Overlay image
deadImage.hint: Path of the image displayed over the token based on failed death saving throws.

overlayColor.name: Overlay image color
overlayColor.hint: Color applied to the overlay icon. Defaults to blood red.

alphaFailure1.name: Opacity with 1 death failure
alphaFailure1.hint: Icon opacity when the character has 1 failed death saving throw.

alphaFailure2.name: Opacity with 2 death failures
alphaFailure2.hint: Icon opacity when the character has 2 failed death saving throws.

alphaFailure3.name: Opacity with 3+ death failures
alphaFailure3.hint: Icon opacity when the character has 3 or more failed death saving throws.

showAtZeroFailures.name: Show icon with 0 failures
showAtZeroFailures.hint: When enabled, shows a very faint icon when the token is at 0 HP even before any failed death saving throws.

alphaFailure0.name: Opacity with 0 failures
alphaFailure0.hint: Only used when “Show icon with 0 failures” is enabled.

fitDeadImageToGrid.name: Fit overlay image to token grid size
fitDeadImageToGrid.hint: When enabled, the icon scales against the full token size: 1x1, 2x2, 3x3, etc. It does not change the actual token size.

overlaySizeRatio.name: Icon size relative to token
overlaySizeRatio.hint: Icon size relative to the token. It is placed in the lower-right corner and the maximum allowed size is 50%.

applyDeadAtThreeFailures.name: Apply Dead status at 3+ failures
applyDeadAtThreeFailures.hint: When death saving throw failures reach 3 or more, applies the Dead status to the actor/token.

removeBloodiedAtDeath.name: Remove Bloodied status on death
removeBloodiedAtDeath.hint: When Dead is applied at 3+ failures, removes Bloodied if present.

deadStatusAsOverlay.name: Apply Dead as status overlay
deadStatusAsOverlay.hint: When enabled, Foundry shows Dead as the system status overlay. Usually this should stay disabled because this module already draws its own icon over the token.

removeDeadWhenHealed.name: Remove Dead when healed
removeDeadWhenHealed.hint: When enabled, automatically removes Dead when the actor rises above 0 HP. Disabled by default so the GM keeps narrative control.
